title: 45-MIN FOUNDATION — WEEK 3 DAY 20
additionalTitle: BODYLINE + CUFF/NECK CONTROL + HINGE + ANKLE DURABILITY

levels.bonus: Optional 5–10 min full rest only. BJJ: Ignition + A×2/B×1/D×1 (19:20), or skip if class/time load is high.

ignition.name: Supine Posterior Pelvic Tilt
ignition.cue: Slow exhale; tiny pain-free tilt; support the legs so no bent-knee position is forced.

deposits.label: A
deposits.title: BODYLINE — FRONT LEVER WITHHELD
deposits.effort: Rest 1:00; RPE 5, 5 RIR. Current rung: bent-knee hollow adjunct; last qualifying user-confirmed lever exposure: NONE VERIFIED. No progression; gate remains two clean 3×15–20-sec tuck-lever exposures after symptoms resolve.

exercises.name: Bent-Knee Hollow Hold
exercises.cue: Arms by sides; choose any comfortable knee angle; stop for shoulder, thigh, or knee symptoms.

deposits.label: B
deposits.title: CUFF + NECK — COMPOUNDS WITHHELD
deposits.effort: Rest 1:20; RPE 3, 6 RIR. Compound pull/press withheld and receives no strength credit. Recovery baseline only; no progression.

exercises.name: Standing Cable External Rotation
exercises.cue: Elbow by ribs; use zero load if needed; skip for AC/biceps pain or radiation.

exercises.name: Seated Chin Tuck
exercises.home: Supported standing or chair chin tuck ×8
exercises.cue: Chin level; glide straight back; shoulders fully relaxed.

deposits.label: C
deposits.title: UNLOADED HINGE + LOWER-LEG DURABILITY
deposits.effort: Rest 1:00; RPE 4, 5 RIR. Hinge rung: unloaded wall pattern; NONE VERIFIED. Establish baseline only; loaded rotation withheld and receives no credit.

exercises.name: Wall Hip Hinge
exercises.cue: Nearly straight, soft knees; shorten range or stop if thigh/knee pain rises.

exercises.name: Seated Heel-and-Toe Raise
exercises.cue: Use a comfortable knee angle; do not force ankle range.

deposits.label: D
deposits.title: WEIGHT ACCEPTANCE — POWER WITHHELD
deposits.effort: Rest 1:30; RPE 3, 6 RIR. New pain-free weight-shift baseline; rotational throw/power receives no credit. Reduce hand support only after two user-confirmed pain-free exposures.

exercises.name: Supported Standing Weight Shift
exercises.cue: Tiny smooth shift; nearly straight knees; stop for pain.

deposits.label: E
deposits.title: ANKLE-PUMP ARMOR
deposits.effort: 6:20 including setup; RPE 2, 6 RIR. Recovery armor only; no aerobic-engine benchmark credit.

exercises.name: Ankle Pumps
exercises.home: Chair or supine—choose the symptom-free position
exercises.cue: Pull toes up and point down smoothly; relax the knee.

martialSupplement.name: Collar-Drag Visualization
martialSupplement.home: Watch exact collar-drag demo; mentally rehearse only
martialSupplement.cue: Separate and optional; no physical reps while symptoms remain unresolved; never auto-log.
